notes.title: Perceptions of the Dead 2 - available now!
notes.content:
Hey all!
[h1]The sequel to this game has just been released on Steam and is available to play.[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/817860/Perceptions_of_the_Dead_2/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31076063/5a23d862630be97872f6c1ee5c3b40452d949d8d.jpg[/img]


[i]
Three months ago, Jill learned ghosts are real. Now she has to save the only Acolyte who can help her live in a world of the dead[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31076063/3936aca0e6a524f9ec474232da2b80b54d4f576a.png[/img]

It was the enthusiasm with which this game was received that inspired us to create part 2. So thank you to all, and we hope that you enjoy the new game!

notes.title: Perceptions of the Dead 2 - Now on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31076063/5a23d862630be97872f6c1ee5c3b40452d949d8d.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]The campaign for part 2 has just begun, stop by and say hello![/b][/h1]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ithaqualabs/perceptions-of-the-dead-2


[h1]In 2011, Tyrone left home to pursue a life as an Acolyte, a Paranormal Problem Solver.[/h1]
Since then he has fought horrors and saved both lives and unlives.  

Today, he's missing.

In October of 2017, Jill Count held an IRL streaming event from within the haunted hospital of Saint Heart. The events there left her forever changed, and able, now, to see ghosts.   

Haunted by the ghost of a young man she met there, Jill travels to find Tyrone, hoping he can help her. 

Finding him missing, she is quickly roped into helping save him.  

Little does she know what she is actually walking into.
